inventory.name: Schneider Electric 400A Molded Case Circuit Breaker

alerts.title: Helipad De-icing Element Group 3 Open Circuit
alerts.message: Ground temperature sensor reporting ice accumulation on Helipad North Vector. De-icing relay R3-A tripped on overcurrent.
alerts.aiDiagnosis: Possible cable sheath fracture due to -65°C wind chill stress or mechanical strain from PistenBully crossing.
alerts.recommendedAction: Isolate breaker CKT-06. Dispatch technician team with thermal camera once blizzard subsides to Level 2.

alerts.title: Genset 2 Front Journal Vibration Exceeded 4.5 mm/s
alerts.message: Fast Fourier Transform spectral analysis detected 120Hz 2nd order harmonic peak on bearing sleeve B3.
alerts.aiDiagnosis: Micro-fatigue pitting on upper bearing shell. RUL estimated at 180 operating hours before critical seizure.
alerts.recommendedAction: Maintain GEN-02 on standby only. Prioritize GEN-01 and Wind Turbines. Schedule bearing swap from spare inventory SP-GEN-109.

alerts.title: Aviation Day Tank D Capacity Dropped Below 50%
alerts.message: Current capacity at 49.4% (22,250L). Reached predefined replenishment notification threshold.
alerts.aiDiagnosis: Normal consumption draw from aviation fueling test cycle.
alerts.recommendedAction: Initiate automated transfer pump PMP-02 from Bulk Tank A to replenish Tank D to 85%.

alerts.title: GSAT-7A Polar Transponder Handover Completed
alerts.message: Elevation angle auto-tracked successfully to 14.8°. Ping stable at 612ms.

alerts.title: Katabatic Storm Front Accelerated - Level 3 Alarm
alerts.message: Barometric pressure gradient delta reached -4.1 hPa/3h. Wind gusts projected to reach 95 knots.
alerts.aiDiagnosis: Polar low pressure vortex converging with continental slope air mass.
alerts.recommendedAction: Enforce station lockdown protocol. Verify external heated safety tethers.

sitrep.powerGridSummary: Main Genset Alpha + 4x Micro-Wind supplying 146.8 kW total load.
sitrep.fuelSummary: 134,250 Litres remaining (225.5 days buffer). Tank B active feed.
sitrep.criticalIncidents: Helipad De-icing circuit failure (isolated). Genset 2 bearing vibration monitored.
sitrep.scientificOperations: Magnetometer & Dobson ozone data transmitting to NCPOR Goa uninterrupted.
